description: Claude Managed Agents adapter (trackSessionEvents / track_session_events / rudderanthropic.TrackSessionEvents). Each scenario feeds its session event streams, in order, to the adapter with `session` (unless options.session is null), user_id user_1 and the price below registered; options.tool_breakdown and options.capture_content turn those settings on. A stream with `cassette` replays that cassette's GET .../events/stream through the real Anthropic client, with the session from its POST /v1/sessions. `stop_after` stops reading after that many events. `expected` lists every emitted event in order; each event's properties without interaction_id, latency_ms and total_paused_ms (and conversation_id when options.session is null) must equal `properties`, entries with the same `interaction` label share one interaction_id and different labels differ, and every event's context.wrapperLibrary.integration is claude-managed-agents.

scenarios.name: live_tool_turn
scenarios.description: A recorded claude-haiku-5-5 turn: bash, then a custom tool answered by the app, then the answer.

scenarios.name: text_turn_capture
scenarios.description: One user message, one model request, the answer; content capture on.

scenarios.name: initial_events_turn
scenarios.description: The user.message was sent with initial_events before the stream opened: the turn still sends a prompt event.

scenarios.name: two_turns
scenarios.description: Two turns in one stream: two answers in one conversation (the session ID).

scenarios.name: custom_tool_pause_resume
scenarios.description: The first stream ends while a custom tool waits on the app (requires_action): the answer pauses. A second stream of the same session resumes it.

scenarios.name: approval_denied
scenarios.description: A tool call paused for approval and the app denied it: the stream continues and the tool counts as denied.

scenarios.name: mcp_tool_error
scenarios.description: An MCP tool fails: its server is the breakdown's mcp_server and the call counts as an error.

scenarios.name: refusal
scenarios.description: The turn ends with stop_reason refusal.

scenarios.name: retries_exhausted
scenarios.description: The model request fails with a rate limit until retries run out.

scenarios.name: budget_reached
scenarios.description: The session pauses at its budget.

scenarios.name: interrupt
scenarios.description: The app interrupts the turn: it ends with end_turn, reported as cancelled.

scenarios.name: subagent_cross_post
scenarios.description: A subagent thread's events cross-posted to the primary stream are not counted (primary thread only).

scenarios.name: outcome_grader
scenarios.description: An outcome session: the grader cycle's usage is one call with agent_name outcome_grader and no model (unpriced).

scenarios.name: fast_mode
scenarios.description: A request at speed fast is service_tier fast.

scenarios.name: duplicate_events
scenarios.description: History and stream overlap (the consolidation pattern): repeated event IDs count once.

scenarios.name: consumer_stops
scenarios.description: The app stops reading mid-turn: the answer is cancelled with the calls seen so far.

scenarios.name: compaction
scenarios.description: The session compacted the thread's context during the turn.

scenarios.name: terminated_after_error
scenarios.description: A terminal MCP connection error ends the session.

scenarios.name: no_session
scenarios.description: Without session or model the calls have no model and stay unpriced; the conversation ID is minted once for the stream.

scenarios.name: child_interrupt
scenarios.description: An interrupt aimed at a subagent thread (session_thread_id) does not cancel the primary turn.

scenarios.name: primary_thread_interrupt
scenarios.description: An interrupt naming a thread the session did not create as a subagent (the primary thread) cancels the turn.

scenarios.name: error_before_turn_events
scenarios.description: A terminal session.error while the session runs, before any model request (a repository that cannot be cloned), is the turn's error.

scenarios.name: paused_then_terminated
scenarios.description: A later stream of a paused session holds only session.status_terminated: the paused answer ends cancelled.

scenarios.name: terminated_after_interrupt
scenarios.description: An interrupted turn that ends with session.status_terminated is cancelled.

scenarios.name: resume_without_echo
scenarios.description: The app answered the custom tool before reopening the stream, so its user.custom_tool_result is not on the second stream: the second stream still resumes the paused answer, without a new prompt event.

scenarios.name: reconnect_with_history
scenarios.description: The second stream reads the session's history (events.list) before the live events, as the reconnect pattern does: events the first stream already counted count once.

scenarios.name: running_after_requires_action
scenarios.description: The session runs again after a requires_action idle (the app answered a subagent's custom tool): a stream that then ends mid-turn cancels the answer instead of pausing it.

scenarios.name: paused_then_error
scenarios.description: A later stream of a paused session holds a terminal session.error, then session.status_terminated: the paused answer ends with that error.

scenarios.name: grader_then_failed_call
scenarios.description: A successful call, a grader cycle, then a failed revision: primary_model stays the agent's model.

scenarios.name: custom_tool_error_after_resume
scenarios.description: A custom tool waiting on the app when the answer paused is counted in the resumed segment, with the error and duration its result reports.

scenarios.name: running_then_budget_reached
scenarios.description: The prompt came with initial_events and the session stopped at its budget before any model request: the turn still sends its answer, without prompt_text.

scenarios.name: running_then_terminated
scenarios.description: The session starts running and is terminated before any other event: the turn still sends its answer.

scenarios.name: denied_after_wait
scenarios.description: A tool call paused for approval and the app denied it 10 s later on a second stream: the denial counts in the resumed segment with the wait as its duration.
